description: Creates or extracts a semantic visual system for websites and applications. Use before major frontend redesigns, multi-page sites, brand-heavy UI, or when an existing codebase needs its visual language made explicit. Produces a compact design contract covering atmosphere, color roles, typography, spacing, components, layout, motion, responsive behavior, imagery, and anti-patterns without forcing a particular framework or design tool.
